sara_devex: Heads up - hit an SDK vs REST parity problem during a trial onboarding. Node SDK lacks POST /models/:id/aliases and its retry classifier is retrying on 404s which blocks our sample app.

ali_sdk: Can you share repro snippets?

mike_onboarding: Repro quick steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/models/m-abc/aliases -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\"name\":\"canary\"}' -> 202 Accepted, alias created async.
2) node sdk helpers.createAlias('m-abc','canary') -> immediate 404; SDK retries then fails.

ben_infra: Sounds like the SDK is misclassifying the endpoint as idempotent. We shouldn't retry 4xx in this case.

ali_sdk: Logs:
```
POST /models/m-abc/aliases
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Content-Type: application/json, X-Request-ID: r123
SDK retry config: { maxRetries: 2, retryOn: ['idempotent', 'server-errors'] }
Response: 404 { error: 'model_not_found' }
```
Our heuristic looked at the trailing resource and assumed idempotent. Bad.

ali_sdk: Workarounds: call REST directly from sample app or set retryOn to only server-errors. Neither great for DX.

mike_onboarding: For onboarding flow, alias creation is async (202) then polling. SDK helper incorrectly assumes sync creation. We'll update the helper or sample app.

sara_devex: Action items:
- ali_sdk: add aliases endpoint to Node SDK and update retry classifier (PR + tests).
- mike_onboarding: change sample app to poll or call REST directly; add integration test.
- ben_infra: verify header casing rules and ensure X-Request-ID normalization isn't breaking routing.
Tag me on PRs. :eyes:

ali_sdk: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2350 (WIP). Adding integration test for 202->poll flow.

deploy-bot: deploying branch sdk/aliases-fix to staging at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z :package:

ben_infra: Filed infra ticket #1102 about header-case and nginx regex.

mike_onboarding: Filed sample app issue #988 and updated runbook with REST workaround.

sara_devex: Good catch. This was the root cause for two trial org failures. Prioritizing this week.
